name: DM01: No. active on ART screened for Diabetes Mellitus (DM) at last visit in the reporting quarter
description:
Number of clients active on ART whose last ART visit during the reporting quarter contains a documented Diabetes Mellitus screening/status assessment.
The patient must have an ART encounter between :startDate and :endDate. The encounter must be the patient's latest ART visit within the reporting quarter. diabetes_mellitus_status must be documented and must not indicate NOT ELIGIBLE. The patient must satisfy the active-care rule: an ART encounter during the reporting period or a return_visit_date after :endDate.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.diabetes_mellitus_status IS NOT NULL
  AND a.encounter_date = (
      SELECT MAX(a2.encounter_date)
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a2
      WHERE a2.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND a2.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
